async def f(items, s):
    for item in items:
        async with s.get(item):
            pass
    for item in items:
        async with s.get(item) as r:
            pass
    for item in items:
        with s.get(item):
            pass
    for item in items:
        with s.get(item) as r:
            pass
    for item in items:
        async with s.a(item) as a, s.b(item) as b:
            pass
    for item in items:
        async with (
            s.a(item) as a,
            s.b(item) as b,
        ):
            pass
